summary: The article provides a generally accurate overview of the 8th Pay Commission's activities and implications, with most factual claims aligning with recent news and official statements.

claims.claim: The 8th Central Pay Commission has commenced its initial meetings in Delhi to gather inputs from various stakeholders.
claims.note: Multiple sources confirm the 8th Pay Commission began stakeholder meetings in Delhi on August 7, 2026, continuing until August 10, 2026.

claims.claim: A visit to Jaipur has also been added to the commission's schedule for broader consultations.
claims.note: The 8th Pay Commission is scheduled to visit Jaipur on August 31 and September 1, 2026, for stakeholder discussions.

claims.claim: Historically, these commissions are formed approximately every ten years, though there is no fixed statutory period.
claims.note: Pay Commissions are typically constituted every 10 years, though there isn't a fixed statutory period. The first was in 1946, and seven have been formed since independence.

claims.claim: The 8th Central Pay Commission has officially begun its stakeholder engagement process. A four-day meeting schedule has commenced in Delhi, where the commission is actively interacting with a wide array of associations, federations, and unions representing central government and Union Territory employees.
claims.note: The 8th CPC started a four-day meeting schedule in Delhi on August 7, 2026, to interact with various employee associations.

claims.claim: The 8th Pay Commission, headed by Justice Ranjana Prakash Desai, was constituted on 3 November 2025 by the Centre to review salaries, pensions, allowances and associated benefits for central government employees and pensioners.
claims.note: The 8th Central Pay Commission was constituted on November 3, 2025, with Justice Ranjana Prakash Desai as chairperson.

claims.claim: His House Rent Allowance (HRA) is 27% of basic pay (for X-class cities), which is ₹20,250.
claims.note: For X-class cities, HRA is 27% of basic pay when Dearness Allowance (DA) crosses 25%.

claims.claim: The commission is tentatively expected to submit its final report to the central government within 18 months of its constitution, i.e., by May-June 2027.
claims.note: The 8th Pay Commission has an 18-month timeframe to submit its recommendations, with an expected submission by May-June 2027.
